id.description: The unique identifier of the claimed prize record

wallet.description: The wallet address that claimed the prize

signature.description: The transaction signature used to claim the prize

mint.description: The coin mint address used for the claim

amount.description: The amount paid to claim the prize (in smallest unit, e.g., lamports)

prize_id.description: The unique identifier of the prize won

prize_name.description: The name of the prize won

data.description: List of claimed prizes for the wallet (action_data excluded for security)
